description: Read an ERC-20 token balance for any wallet on Base or Ethereum via public RPC eth_call — no key, no indexer. Use this when an agent needs to any token balance for any wallet, via public RPC. x402 price $0.02/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: crypto_token_balance
